title: Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance Relationship Reduction of the Surrender Charge Percentage on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
The owner of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract who keeps an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy in force, with recent premium payments, has the surrender percentage reduced on full surrender.

## Rule

The capped surrender percentage is reduced, never below zero, by **0.50 percentage point (0.005)** where the owner holds an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy with at least **12** whole life premium payments in the twelve months before the handling date, by **0.25 percentage point (0.0025)** where the owner holds an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy with at least one but fewer than 12 such payments, and not at all otherwise. The result is the reduced surrender percentage.

## Evidence read

1. The owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy and its current status — it must be in force.
2. The premium payment entries in that policy's activity history dated in the twelve months before the handling date.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Owner's Whole Life Insurance policy | Premium payments in the twelve months before handling | Capped surrender percentage | Reduced surrender percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| In force | 12 | 3% | 2.50% |
| In force | 4 | 3% | 2.75% |
| In force | 0 | 3% | 3% |
| Lapsed | 12 | 3% | 3% |
| In force | 12 | 0.40% | 0% (never below zero) |
| None | — | 5% | 5% |
